name: Pelliconi
verdict: Owned by the Pelliconi family (100% family-owned Italian closures maker). Nothing found.
note: Closures (bottle-cap) maker based at Ozzano dell'Emilia (Bologna). Its own site calls it an official sponsor of Virtus (pelliconi.it/etica); on the front left chest of the 2026/27 black EuroLeague home jersey per the club store's product photo.
